query:
SELECT room_id AS "room_id!: RoomId"
             FROM room_favorites rf
             WHERE rf.user_id = $1
               AND rf.room_id = ANY($2)
               AND EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1
                   FROM room_members rm
                   WHERE rm.user_id = rf.user_id AND rm.room_id = rf.room_id
               )
